newsitem.title: UK: LPC- Banks launch Madrid Metro loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC- Banks launch Madrid Metro loan.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 12 (LPC) - Arrangers Argentaria, CajaMadrid, ABN AMRO and Societe Generale have launched syndication of a 43.5 billion peseta ($340.6 million) credit for Madrid's Areas de Promocion Empresarial (Arpejio), bankers said.
Commerzbank, Credit Local de France and Sumitomo have joined the deal as co-underwriters.
Banks are offered a top upfront fee of 12.5 bps for commitments of 1.5 billion pesetas.

The 12 year credit, which is priced at 20 bps over LIBOR with a 10 bps commitment fee, will be used to fund the construction of a new line for the Madrid metro, as well as the acquisition of new rolling stock.
Repayment is in 19 semi-annual payments, the first being due December 30, 1999.
The drawdown period is two years from the date of signing, and the credit is 20 percent risk weighted. Arpejio is an authority of the Communidad de Madrid.
